_doc: THE PINNED EVALUATION SET — work/2026-08-02-lora-beat-e07 P0.4.
Every sample sheet, A/B and per-epoch selection reads THIS file, so the user is choosing
between models rather than between rolls of the dice. Change it and every prior number
becomes incomparable, so treat it as frozen for the life of a comparison and record any
Why it exists: the 6-species x e/s x 3-seed A/B that produced the shipping `e07` verdict was
driven ad hoc. Only its OUTPUTS survive (.staging/ab5); the driver was never committed, so
the verdict cannot be reproduced from the repo. See issues I6.
`model` — the BASE CHECKPOINT, animagine-xl-4.0 since 2026-08-02 (P1.2). It was
cyberrealisticXL_v80, a PHOTOREALISM finetune, purely because that was the sole SDXL
checkpoint on the box in March (issues I5). The no-LoRA probe measured this base at 4/4 east
cells wider than tall (mean aspect 1.89) against Illustrious-XL's 0/4 (1.02) — bodies in side
profile rather than busts. Illustrious is NOT ruled out for a later attempt (user, 2026-08-02).
`size` — 1024, SDXL-native for this base (forks F6). It was 768, which entered the project as
a 2080 Ti VRAM accommodation rather than a decision.
positive: rd_style, rd_animal, rd_quadruped, {rd}, {phrase}, {family}, {name}, single creature, full body, white background
negative: realistic, photo, photorealistic, 3d render, blurry, multiple, sprite sheet, grid, collage, close-up, portrait, logo, emblem, frame, background scenery, text, watermark

e: side profile, side view, facing right
s: front view, facing the viewer, facing forward

_dirs_note: n (back view) is deliberately OUT of the scored set: the historical comparison was e/s only. `n` is generated for review, not scored. NOTE (issues I7): BOTH candidate bases failed on front views with no LoRA at all, so `s` is expected to stay the weak direction.

n: back view, facing away, seen from behind

_subjects_note: [name, family, corpus folder under .staging/animal-lora, file stem]. All six are IN the training corpus by design — this set measures fidelity to our own art, not generalisation. The anteater check (P4) is the separate generalisation test and is deliberately not scored here.
